author: Corey Elam
title: 10 Harlan County students taken to hospital in school bus crash, SUV driver hurt - NewsBreak
text:
By Corey Elam ,
15 hours ago
HARLAN COUNTY, Ky. ( FOX 56 ) — Kentucky State Police troopers announced on Thursday morning that 10 students had been taken to the hospital along with a school bus driver and an SUV driver after a highway crash.
It happened shortly after 7:30 a.m. on Oct. 8, according to a Facebook post from state police . First responders were dispatched to the Ross Point Elementary School cutoff on US Highway 119.
LATEST KENTUCKY NEWS: Investigators wrote that the crash involved an SUV and a school bus, with multiple ambulances sent to the area. No roads have reportedly been closed in the crash investigation.
"Kentucky State Police will provide additional information as it becomes available," state troopers wrote on Thursday morning. "Please use caution in the area and allow emergency responders room to work."
A preliminary investigation showed that the school bus was pulling out from Kentucky Highway 522 and making a left-hand turn onto northbound US-119 when it allegedly entered the path of a Honda SUV.
District officials with Harlan County Public Schools said "at least two students" suffered "apparent minor injuries" and were taken to Harlan Appalachian Regional Health (ARH).
School leaders said the bus had been bound for Harlan County High School with 23 students in tow when the crash occurred.
Berea bank shooting suspect’s arraignment delayed again "As a precaution, additional students have been transported for medical observation," Harlan County school officials wrote around 8 a.m. on Thursday. "The families of the injured students have been notified. Multiple emergency agencies are on the scene."
Around 9:50 a.m. on Thursday, KSP officials wrote that nine total students were taken to the hospital by emergency personnel, with a tenth student taken to the hospital by a parent. The bus driver was also taken for an evaluation.
Authorities said the driver of the Honda SUV was taken to the hospital for treatment of her injuries.
None of the injuries in Thursday's crash were reported to be life-threatening, per state police.
The crash investigation is still ongoing.
